messages:
anya: Heads-up 1 Jun: joint webinar with Nimbus Cloud + HardwarePartners. Need speaker confirmations, demo fallback plan, and a contactless swag pickup flow. Who can take which action?
michael: I can do speaker outreach and collect bios. Can we get final names by Fri EOD?
ravi: I'll own demo ops. Thinking primary demo on Nimbus sandbox rack, fallback is a local CPU-only demo + 90s recorded clip. Also need an ethernet port & HDMI.
zoe: Marketing will need headshots + 1-sentence blurbs and preferred pronouns for slide templates. Deadline Thu. Also creating landing page CTA.
anya: For swag: proposal 1 QR-based locker pickup. Attendees get an email + QR; volunteer scans to open locker. Safer than booth lines. Thoughts?
michael: Sounds good. Add a small promo card inside so we can track conversion. Also can we limit 1 pack per reg to avoid hoarding?
ravi: Locker dimensions? If it's too small, we'd need staffed table instead. Venue rep said lockers available near Hall B. Asking for exact size now.
ops-bot: calendar: "Nimbus x HWPartners Webinar" added Jun 21 11:00-12:00 PT. Dry run on Jun 19 09:00 PT. Invites sent.
zoe: Volunteer plan: 10:30-11:30 lead @ravi, 11:30-12:15 backup @michael. Can Nimbus provide one staffer?
anya: Nimbus confirmed a staffer (Tina). Also recommended we ship swag earlier May 19 to their warehouse.
michael: Ship manifest please. I need counts for the promo card text.
ravi: Draft manifest: 
```
- 100 sticker bundles
- 40 micro-USB demo plugs (pre-staged)
- 20 "dev key" dongles
- 120 one-page quickstart cards
```
I'll add weight/dimensions and courier label info tonight.
zoe: Run-of-show: slides due Jun 12, dry run Jun 19, final PDF uploaded Jun 20. We should rehearse the fallback handoff: moderator to call fallback and switch to local demo within 60s.
anya: Agreed. Moderator (anya) will have scripts for fallback transitions and video link pinned. Also avoid mentioning proprietary benchmarks in the talk.
ops-bot: reminder: Dry run scheduled Jun 19 09:00 PT. Auto-notify panelists 24h prior.
michael: For locker QR flow: attendee receives unique QR on registration; scanning triggers volunteer to release locker. Volunteer UI will be a simple mobile page. @ravi can you test flow during dry run?
ravi: Yep. I'll bring a spare phone + mini router. Also packing 2x HDMI adapters, spare ethernet cable, and a tiny switch.
zoe: PR/legal: don't use absolute latency/cost numbers without sign-off. Use qualitative language.
anya: Final checklist: 1) speakers + bios by Fri, 2) manifest & weights by Mon, 3) slides Jun 12, 4) dry run Jun 19. I'll DM owners. Thanks all :rocket:
